Container.Name: Manga Maid
Container.Overview: Manga Maid — sync MangaDex and Suwayomi sources into your Kavita library. Downloads new chapters on a schedule, writes ComicInfo.xml metadata, and provides a web UI for series, jobs, and settings.
Container.Description: Manga Maid — sync MangaDex and Suwayomi sources into your Kavita library. Downloads new chapters on a schedule, writes ComicInfo.xml metadata, and provides a web UI for managing your sync list and settings.

Config.Name: Manga Path
Config.Description: Path to your manga library folder. Must be writable — this is where chapters are downloaded.

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Persistent storage for config, database, and logs.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the container runs as. Match this to your Kavita/media user to avoid permission issues. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the container runs as. Unraid default is 100 (users).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Your local timezone (e.g. Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo). Used for sync schedule display.

Config.Name: Default Language
Config.Description: Preferred chapter language code (e.g. en, it, fr, ja-ro). Used when adding new series.
